__baseline_prompt__.text: A photographic space-horror scene records a dangerous moment aboard a spacecraft. At the right side of a wide rectangular hatch, a woman whose facial appearance and hairstyle follow the supplied portrait crouches beside the final clamp of a temporary clear pressure partition. Her dark chin-length bob and wispy fringe frame large brown eyes, softly rounded cheeks and natural pink lips. Her concentrated face carries an intimate, vulnerable presence within the emergency; a small sheen of perspiration catches the work light. She wears a fitted off-white thermal coverall with worn utility seams. The corridor around her still holds breathable air. Beyond the transparent partition, two frost-coated cryogenic storage capsules flank a torn opening in the ship's outer wall, exposing small sharp stars in black space. The partition is the thin physical boundary preserving the corridor. Its upper and side edges are already captured by evenly spaced metal clamps; its clear sheet bows away from her into the depressurized bay. At the lower-right corner, a short unfinished seam remains visibly open just to the left of a red over-center lever. Fine white condensation threads stream through that gap away from the corridor toward the open bay. She has one knee on the corridor floor and the opposite boot planted firmly beside her. Her right hand closes around the red lever, folding it toward the lower-right jamb; her left palm braces the same solid jamb above the clamp. Her arms remain on the corridor side of the sheet. She watches the remaining gap as she works, lips slightly parted, with the incompletely closed lever and the escaping threads visible together. Photograph from the corridor at a shallow oblique angle, wide enough to include all four partition edges, her face, both connected arms, the grounded knee and boot, and the torn hull beyond. Keep the clamp large and unobstructed beside her hand. A warm portable work lamp describes her face and fingers against cold blue reflections on the transparent sheet; a dim red service beacon recedes into the bay. The vulnerable clear surface, purposeful hand, and indifferent patch of outer space form the photograph's visual hierarchy, with tactile condensation and restrained documentary grain.
